Small molecule structure elucidation from NMR spectra with generative and reasoning models.

The authors present an AI system that automates de novo small-molecule structure elucidation from NMR spectra by combining a generative model (CHEFNMR2, an atomic flow-matching model) with a scientific reasoning agent. This addresses the labor-intensive, expert-dependent bottleneck of NMR interpretation, potentially accelerating structure determination in chemistry and drug discovery.

MultiTargetDB: a comprehensive database of multitarget ligands for polypharmacology research and drug discovery.

MultiTargetDB is a new database that curates multitarget ligands—small molecules that bind multiple biological targets—along with detailed biological annotations and measurement-level provenance. It integrates chemical structures, molecular scaffolds, and drug development stages to support polypharmacology research and rational multitarget drug discovery. This resource addresses the scarcity of well-curated, dedicated databases for multitarget drug discovery.

Integrating Multisource Target Evidence with Machine-Learning Potency Prediction for Alzheimer's Disease Drug Discovery.

The authors built an integrated data-to-model platform for Alzheimer's disease drug discovery that consolidates target evidence from biological, chemical, structural, regulatory, and trial-registry sources into a traceable resource covering 967 targets, 452,249 compounds, and over 1.4 million measurements. They also show that fine-tuning the Boltz-2 affinity prediction head on a curated PIK3CA dataset substantially improves potency prediction accuracy (Pearson r from 0.248 to 0.560). The work aims to make AD target evaluation and machine-learning modeling more reproducible and accessible.
